# Sample media stand-ins (tests/fixtures/offline/media/)

The site's demos, docs and examples use **remote** sample media (picsum.photos,
i.pravatar.cc, placehold.co, images.unsplash.com, ui-avatars.com, archive.org,
freemusicarchive, w3schools and MDN sample clips, pixabay ...), exactly as in
production. The tests never touch the internet: `tests/fixtures/offline.ts`
answers every such request with one of the files in this folder. The site's
markup is not changed -- only the test browser's network is.

## Licence

**Every file in this folder was generated by this repository** -- nothing was
downloaded, photographed, recorded or sampled. There is no third-party
copyright and no attribution requirement:

- **Source:** `scripts/generate-sample-media.mjs`, driven by
  `scripts/sample-media-catalog.mjs` (fixed seeds, so it re-renders the same
  scenes).
- **Licence:** original work of Cielo Vista Software, covered by this
  repository's own licence (see `LICENSE`).
- **Tools used, not content:** [sharp](https://sharp.pixelplumbing.com/)
  (Apache-2.0) rasterises the procedurally drawn SVG scenes; the ffmpeg build
  Playwright installs (LGPL-2.1) encodes the video frames to VP8/WebM; the
  `lameenc` Python package (LAME, LGPL) encodes the synthesised PCM to MP3.
  Encoders impose no licence on their output.
- The avatars are illustrations drawn from shapes; they depict no real person.

Rule for anything added later: only media that is **generated here** or
**CC0 / public domain** may be committed (the repo is proprietary). Never
NC, ND, SA or unknown-licence media. Add a row below with its source and
licence.

## Regenerating

```sh
node scripts/generate-sample-media.mjs      # re-render this folder
```

## Mapping (remote URL -> stand-in)

Decided at request time by `localFor()` in `scripts/sample-media-catalog.mjs`
(deterministic): a remote placeholder photo of W x H becomes a photo of the
nearest aspect-ratio family (3x2, 16x10, 2x1, 4x3, 1x1, 16x9, 4x1, 2x3), picked
by a hash of its seed; a pravatar / ui-avatars id becomes an avatar; a
placehold.co URL becomes the SVG with the same size, colours and text (one not
catalogued is drawn on the fly by the fixture); audio tracks and video clips
map as listed in `localFor()`.
